summary: PRIORITY (coordinator 08:30Z, the 0.955/0.956 wave): no public source was found. The jumps are spread 0.954-0.962 and all come from subs made 23:21-01:48 UTC, right after the daily quota reset, landing together after ~6-8 h of scoring. That points to many teams' own x138+ tweaks, plus any private or Discord sharing, not one public recipe. The E10 trigger is NOT met. The E10 trigger (a public x138 heir >= 0.956) has NOT fired. There are no new discussion topics or comments and no host announcement. findings.what: Source check for the 0.955/0.956 wave (coordinator priority). (1) The lead 'RANK1-0.961-V8-x138-s3forks (gwey1025/biohub-ends77-s3forks v352580960, ref 56541576)' comes from the README of https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/kragglenote2forwork/biohub-sub-cache2 ('Cached biohub tracking submission CSVs', CC0, updated ~20:06 UTC 25 Sep, 5 downloads). The README says 'Recovered submission files from the checkmyacckraggle repo' and lists sub1.csv (the 0.961 file) plus four koushikrudra files at 0.942/0.926/0.902/0.902, one named 'metric-hack-last-call-update'. gwey1025 has no public biohub kernel (kernels list --user gwey1025 shows only an RSNA notebook; kernels and datasets searches for 'ends77' and 's3forks' find nothing). gwey1025 and koushikrudra are both on team 'Abnormal Guys' (#47, 0.961, 112 subs, last sub 2026-09-25 06:04:39, unchanged since round 6). So this is a private x138 variant (name tokens: x138 base, 's3forks', 'ends77'), 0.961 since 25 Sep morning, and NOT the source of an overnight wave. The cached CSVs are ~12.8 MB each (127.85 MB for 10 files), the size of our own visible-test (4 dummy clips) submission.csv (12.2-12.7 MB in exp02/06/10/29). They are visible-test outputs that cannot score on the hidden ~97-clip rerun, and the dataset owner stays at 0.947 (#1022). (2) https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/fagbolapeter/biohub-trained-4ep (124 downloads spread 21-25 Sep, 46 on 21 Sep) is val40_ab.csv, a 'pretrained' vs 'trained_4ep' comparison on 40 train clips in which the retrain is mostly worse, plus a tracking repo and backup weights. Its owner is at 0.908, so it is not the wave. (3) koushikrudra/biohub-zerogpu-consensus-v1 is a cached CSV (round 6). (4) Discussion since 25 Sep 12:00 UTC holds only Gabriel's one-line comment (~22:20 UTC) under 'Beginner question: How do Public/Private splits...', already read in round 3. There is no new topic and no announcement. (5) An all-Kaggle kernels search for 'biohub' by recency adds only ghazarosghazaros/biohub-dae-alpha-0-15-public-copy (25 Sep 13:48; the DAE prefilter, known idea I-159, closed; owner 0.948) and anvithpothula/biohub-v1284-head-s075-notebook (24 Sep; x138's head notebook, already known). (6) Wave shape: teams >=0.955 went 146 (22:16 25 Sep) -> 149 (00:47) -> 154 (03:16) -> 156 (05:46) -> 171 (08:22). This window 15 teams reached >=0.955 (8 at 0.955, 2 at 0.956, 2 at 0.957, one each at 0.958/0.961/0.962; 8 came from 0.953) and 15 reached exactly 0.954 (8 from 0.953, 7 from 0.946-0.952). Their subs are between 23:21 and 01:48 UTC. That is a spread of scores rather than one cluster, and the timing matches the daily-quota reset plus the ~6-8 h scoring lag. The most likely reading is many teams' own x138+ tweaks (like our insertion) scored in one batch, plus private or Discord sharing we cannot see.
